title_zh: 为失约道歉并重新约好见面

scenario.label_zh: 向朋友道歉并重新安排见面
scenario.goal_zh: 承认失约及其影响，澄清彼此感受并约定下一次见面

context_zh: 两位大学时期的好友谈论上周未能成行的见面，试着恢复联系。
author: author-phase07-a

sentences.speaker: Ari
sentences.text: I'm sorry I left you waiting last Saturday. I need to confess something: I didn't miss a train. I forgot our plan.

sentences.speaker: Bea
sentences.text: I was hurt, especially when you blamed the transport. Why didn't you just tell me?

sentences.speaker: Ari
sentences.text: I was embarrassed. There's no one else to blame, and I should have been honest.

sentences.speaker: Bea
sentences.text: We had such a strong bond at university. I miss seeing you, but I need to know when you're actually coming.

sentences.speaker: Ari
sentences.text: I miss it too. Could we try again this Sunday at eleven? I'll put it in my calendar now.

sentences.speaker: Bea
sentences.text: Yes, at the café near my flat. Besides, we never finished talking about your new job.

sentences.speaker: Ari
sentences.text: Eleven on Sunday, then. If anything changes, I'll tell you before you leave home.

sentences.speaker: Bea
sentences.text: All right. I'm glad you told me the truth.

targets.sense_zh: 承认自己做错或隐瞒的事
人与人之间的亲密纽带
